t27b_x86_64.note: host build: build/asm work, the JIT does not (exit 74)

tools.harness: about 1,650 lines of Python/Zig/C in the lab scratch directory /tmp/bench, not committed (owner rule, #8236)

method_notes.A: t27b: qemu t27b-aarch64 corpus specs --json --runner qemu --timeout-ms 60000 --jobs 6 --reference t27c (reference = t27c test-report, zig Debug on x86_64). zig/gcc/clang: generate, compile for aarch64-linux, list tests, run each test in its own qemu-aarch64 process (120 s per test, 600 s per compile), 6 files in parallel. rustc: generate + compile only.
method_notes.B: process wall time from spawn to exit, one process at a time, round-robin over specs and pipelines, 6 rounds; round 0 reported as cold, rounds 1-5 as warm (median, min). zig: fresh ZIG_LOCAL_CACHE_DIR per sample, warm global cache. t27b natively: t27b-x86_64 test S (exits 74 at the JIT map, after code generation) and t27b-x86_64 build S -o x.o.
method_notes.C: timing: every test once per process, CLOCK_MONOTONIC around each call inside the guest, 5 rounds; sums over tests every pipeline ran. icount: qemu TCG plugin, window between getppid() markers (zig, C) or blocks inside mprotect(PROT_EXEC) regions (t27b JIT). size: t27b JIT image bytes; zig nm sizes of spec_all.* code symbols (refAllDecls build); gcc/clang .text* of gen-c object; rustc and t27b build: objects without tests.
method_notes.D: max RSS of the process tree from wait4 ru_maxrss via a static fork/exec helper (floor 840 KiB), max over 3 runs per spec.
method_notes.E: each tier-1 spec built twice in one directory (fresh caches) and once in another directory; sha256 of every output.
